Netlink tile APIs, topology setup, and IPv4 neighbor solicitation helpers.

# Purpose
This header declares the interface for the netlink tile used by the Firedancer topology. It defines hardcoded limits for network devices and bond masters, exposes the `fd_tile_netlnk` tile descriptor, and declares the [`fd_netlink_topo_create`](<#fd_netlink_topo_create>) and [`fd_netlink_topo_join`](<#fd_netlink_topo_join>) functions used to set up and attach the tile in a topology. It also defines `fd_netlink_neigh4_solicit_link_t` and the inline [`fd_netlink_neigh4_solicit`](<#fd_netlink_neigh4_solicit>) helper, which publishes IPv4 neighbor solicitation requests, such as ARP requests, to the tile through an mcache link.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_netlink_topo_create`
- `fd_netlink_topo_join`
